chunks: Wailing is from the practice of the Age of Ignorance.

key_terms.اَلنِّيَاحَةُ: Wailing or lamentation over the dead
key_terms.عَمَلِ اَلْجَاهِلِيَّةِ: A practice belonging to the pre-Islamic Age of Ignorance

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about wailing over the dead?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns niyahah, meaning ritualized wailing and lamentation associated with pre-Islamic jāhili practices. It teaches that such behavior belongs to the ethos of ignorance rather than the Prophetic way.
